data.content_ref: inline:This conjecture depends on SRC_003: the RESIDUE label of SRC_009 reduces to a refinement of the suspend_reason diagnostic, because every RESIDUE value — the accepted attacker that kept the node out — must fall inside the direct_attack or mutual_attack case that suspend_reason already classifies, so RESIDUE is suspend_reason with the causal witness made explicit and its determinism is inherited rather than re-established. REFUTED IF there exists a final labeling in which a node's RESIDUE names an accepted attacker while its suspend_reason is insufficient_defense — i.e., if RESIDUE ever attributes an exclusion to an accepted attacker that suspend_reason does not also attribute.
